key_insight: TransXplainRRG combines chest X-ray analysis, patient history, and expert-guided report refinement, outperforming MAIRA-2 on GREEN clinical-consistency scores in the reported evaluation.
clinical_relevance: The framework aims to make automated chest X-ray reports more clinically relevant and interpretable, but its suitability for routine clinical use remains unestablished.
method: Uses a Swin Transformer vision encoder and a transformer-based text encoder incorporating patient medical history.
Applies an expert-guided “inside-out” approach and abnormal-finding extraction to refine reports.
Combines transformer encoders with LLMs for report generation and refinement.
evidence_signal: Trained and tested on MIMIC-CXR and evaluated on unseen IU X-Ray data, it achieved GREEN scores of 0.327 and 0.605, respectively, with preliminary radiologist evaluation of 100 generated reports.
watch_item: Preliminary expert review and benchmark performance do not establish prospective clinical safety or workflow benefit.
paper_title: TransXplainRRG: A Radiologist-Evaluated LVLM for Chest Radiograph Report Generation
